changes.description: Call create_otp immediately after authority passes. Reuse a pending code, which remains valid for this call. Retry generation only after a confirmed failure with retry_allowed=true. Generation and verification share one retry; successful generation and carrier rechecks do not restore it. On OTP_FAILED close and finalize without another OTP attempt.

Call verify_otp only with six caller-dictated digits as a string, preserving zeros. Clarify incomplete digits without a tool call. On failure with retry_allowed=true ask for the same screen code again. The second OTP failure across generation and verification ends the flow. Never invent, disclose or read back digits; no protected load access before verified=true.

After AUTHORITY_REQUIRED or OTP_REQUIRED satisfy the missing prerequisite before protected actions. A carrier change invalidates verification while retaining spent OTP failures. Verification otherwise lasts for the remaining call; never request verification solely because time passed. On OTP_FAILED stop and finalize; do not regenerate or recheck to restore a retry.

Explain technical failures truthfully without fabricated data. A confirmed OTP failure may use the one shared retry only when retry_allowed=true; distinguish a service failure from a wrong code. A second generation or verification failure closes with technical_error when technical, or conversation_complete for wrong-code exhaustion. An uncertain result or unavailable authoritative state requires technical closure without another OTP attempt.

Do not retry uncertain mutations automatically. The backend may reconcile an OTP result from its saved receipt; the agent follows only the confirmed result and retry_allowed. OTP_RESULT_UNCERTAIN or OTP_OPERATION_CHANGED requires truthful technical closure. Expressly permitted negotiation/finalization duplicate delivery must use identical arguments.
